about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: My journey in software began with curiosity about how things work. That curiosity turned into a passion for building solutions that truly help businesses grow.
about.paragraph2: I specialize in working with entrepreneurs and startups that need to digitize their operations. I know every dollar counts and you need results, not promises.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Where I've built and shipped product

highlights: Designed and built from scratch the main control dashboard for the core tool of Disso's threat management system.
Built AI agents and background processes for human risk analysis and management.
Owned architecture and delivery end to end as an early engineer.
Led the migration of the restaurant support area to artificial intelligence models.
Worked on an infrastructure of 1,000+ microservices, keeping critical systems scalable and performant.
Led development of web applications for financial projects, managing a team of 3 developers.
Built a reusable component library from scratch.
Designed and implemented APIs in Node.js and Python to integrate external payment and financial services.
Designed and implemented a GraphQL API for the migration of the entire ERP platform to a new stack.
Built SQL reports for the company's analytics platform.
